intro: Mobile car and boat detailing in Las Vegas. We bring the wash to your driveway, dock or lot and get every detail by hand.

mobile.title: We come to your boat.
mobile.intro: Mobile service means your boat gets cared for right where it sits, with no haul to a shop.

points.name: At your place
points.text: We come to your home or location in Las Vegas, Henderson, Boulder City and North Las Vegas.

points.name: No shop run
points.text: No drop-off and no pickup. One customer did the job right in their driveway.

points.name: Inside and out
points.text: Interior vacuum and wipe-down, wheels, windows and paint, all handled on site.

points.name: Open every day
points.text: Monday to Sunday, 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. Call (702) 800-9447 to book.

servicesIntro: From regular washes to full restoration, priced and planned around your boat.

services.name: Boats
services.text: Boat cleaning and detailing, sized to your vessel.

services.name: R & J Famous Butter Wash
services.text: Wax foam soap, bug and iron remover, wheels and tires, full interior vacuum and wipe-down, windows inside and out.

services.name: R & J's Full Inside Detail
services.text: Sanitized door pockets, vacuumed carpets and seats, cleaned headliner and vents, detailed dash and console.

services.name: Clay Bar Cleaning with Sealant
services.text: Clay treatment leaves paint smooth, then a sealant adds UV and water protection for up to 60 days.

services.name: Car or Sedan New Look Package
services.text: Full inside detail, plastic trim renewal, headlight renewal and an engine bay wash.

services.name: Ceramic Coating
services.text: Long-lasting protection against scratches, UV rays and chemical contaminants, up to 3 years.

why.name: Quality and convenience
why.text: Professional care right at your location.

why.name: Competitive rates
why.text: Clear prices, listed up front for cars, trucks, boats and RVs.

howTitle: Ready for the water in three steps.

steps.name: Tell us about your boat
steps.text: Call or send the form with the vessel and what you need.

steps.name: We assess and plan
steps.text: We inspect the surface and set the right correction and protection.

steps.name: Back on the water
steps.text: Your boat returns with deep gloss and lasting protection.
